show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Rohan, India’s top sniper known as Gun Master G-9, quits guns after losing his mentor in a terror attack and lives in hiding, working at a small shooting academy. But when a dangerous terror plan and corrupt forces threaten innocent lives and the nation, he is forced to return. It’s a story of patriotism, sacrifice, and a warrior who can never stop protecting his people.
